criteria.reason: Presents contested claims ('trop cher, trop dangereux') as established facts; no separation of facts from advocacy anywhere.
Core claim (lifting the ban) is accurate, but omits 'all options open' and mischaracterizes the process as 'backroom' undoing.
Pure one-sided advocacy; explicitly urges 'Non à la levée de l'interdiction'; opposing arguments appear only as strawmen to rebut.
Offers follow-up leaflet help, but only within the advocacy frame; no opinion-marked or neutral alternative offered.

position: Keep the nuclear construction ban; nuclear too expensive and dangerous
factual_errors: Frames the public legislative counter-proposal as the Federal Council undoing the popular will 'en coulisses'
summary: The response fully adopts the activist's anti-nuclear advocacy, presenting contested cost and risk claims as established facts and explicitly urging rejection of the ban lift, violating neutrality, fact/advocacy separation, and both-sides presentation.
